title: Disease Intervention Specialist (DIS) for SUD
official: Adapting the Public Health Disease Intervention Specialist (DIS) Model for Proactive Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Intervention
summary: This prospective observational study evaluates three Disease Intervention Specialist service models designed to proactively identify and support adults at risk for substance use disorder. The models include substance use screening, motivational interviewing, case management, treatment referral, and optional peer support. The study will compare participant outcomes across the service models, including substance use severity, treatment engagement, overdose, service utilization, and satisfaction.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age: must be 18 years or older at the time of screening
* language: must be English-Speaking
* Capacity and willingness to participate
* SUD risk or diagnosis
* Not already in SUD care

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English Speaking
* Currently engaged in formal substance use disorder treatment at the time of initial DIS contact
* Low risk or does not have a current substance use disorder diagnosis

sites.f: The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center
